mapper.select: select distinct oi.dish_id from order_item oi join orders o on oi.order_id = o.id where o.user_id = #{userId}

select oi2.dish_id as dishId, count(*) as cnt from order_item oi1 join orders o1 on oi1.order_id = o1.id and o1.user_id = #{userId} join order_item oi2 on oi2.order_id = oi1.order_id and oi2.dish_id <> oi1.dish_id group by oi2.dish_id order by cnt desc limit #{limit}
